# OPoll Market

> The world's first social prediction market platform. Trade on real-world events across crypto, sports, politics and culture — available on web, Telegram and WhatsApp.

OPoll Market lets users create and trade prediction markets, follow other traders, copy-trade winners, and earn from accurate forecasts. Markets settle against verifiable real-world outcomes and use an AMM-style pricing model.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Discover trending prediction markets and start trading.
- [Welcome](/welcome): Introduction to OPoll Market for new visitors.
- [Feed](/feed): Live social feed of market activity and predictions.
- [Create Market](/create): Create your own prediction market on any real-world event.
- [Rankings](/rankings): Leaderboard of top traders by PnL and volume.
- [FAQ](/faq): Frequently asked questions about deposits, markets, fees and verification.
- [Disclaimer](/disclaimer): Risk disclosures and legal notices.
- [Privacy](/privacy): Privacy policy.
- [Terms](/terms): Terms of service.
- [Data Use](/data-use): How user data is collected and processed.
- [Child Safety](/child-safety): Child safety standards.
